modality_prompt:
Read rooms -> room_name -> objects/npcs -> unique name. Use the exact name key as the entity action target. NPC keys are simplified lowercase names, such as weiguo or nainai; copy them exactly. Suffixes such as _1 distinguish names; stable identities retain their assigned names.
Every object and NPC includes location=[x,y]; an unavailable object location is null. Coordinates use world XY in meters, matching agent_state.location and room navigation anchors. A location describes the entity at capture time; null means unavailable. XY separation is a planar distance estimate and does not establish visibility, path length or interaction success. Keep entity action targets as exact name keys; navigate/relative distance remains in meters.
For objects, burning is the fire-state flag and remaining_percent is the unburned percentage: 100 means no burn loss and 0 fully burned. For NPCs, health is the raw simulator health value; apply only scales or thresholds explicitly supplied. fire_affected is the reported fire-state flag; it is not a complete injury assessment. is_safe is a boolean indicating whether the NPC's observed XY lies inside a configured safe area, including its boundary and ignoring Z. It is recalculated from each observed position and becomes false after leaving the area; it does not imply a follow/stop command result or replace health. room=unknown means room membership could not be established.
agent_state supplies your position, heading, room and following_npcs. Follower lists contain system-assigned names: [] is an empty report, null is unavailable, and newly_following_npcs identifies additions to the prior report.
memory_state.known_objects groups the latest record emitted to the model for each entity by room, including its saved location. It is historical evidence, and last_seen_action identifies the action that emitted the saved record. Keep this registry out of memory_update.note.
